reviewScope.summary: Reviewed the Guild permissions and canonical routes added to the previously certified consolidation on PR #91. Compared the final diff against master 2c1201930b403e4c081de212ca59ae9ca9a2f067. The SQL upgrade preserves the function identity, grants, membership checks and existing data. The sync implementation, sync provider files, CI, and bundle limits match master.
evidence: Hosted run 43260049243 attempt 1 passed for the previous PR head d71ec8c45fb1aad65da517641ee82767eef03f45. This is historical evidence for the retained consolidation.

The permission follow-up passed 43 focused Vitest cases, nine managed Chromium cases, then reran the Guild and offline bookmark cases on the final redirect component. TypeScript, changed-file ESLint and Prettier, git diff --check, production build and bundle checks passed. Final JS gzip was 458195 bytes, with 343345 bytes for the largest raw JS file and 19101 bytes of CSS gzip.

The disposable PostgreSQL probe passed both upgrade guards, administrator rename and revoke, regular-member invite and leave, rejection of stale and foreign memberships, active-code replacement and the eight-member cap. The mocked browser accepts and copies a member-issued code and keeps administrator controls hidden for the member.

The Guild spec passed again on the final candidate. It checks rendered word fragments, full heading width and placement below both controls at 320 CSS pixels, along with focus, exact read counts, duplicate suppression, refresh failure and retry, rename permissions, explicit sharing, stale membership and account isolation.

Both PR #90 account-sync browser journeys passed before the CSS correction. The final production build passed the unchanged master limits with 458064 bytes of JS gzip, 343107 bytes for the largest raw JS file and 19101 bytes of CSS gzip.

Inspected full Guild screenshots at 320 CSS pixels and the header at native 200% Chromium zoom. The 40-character name wraps between words. At 200% and 309 CSS pixels, all four styles in both color modes passed title and control geometry, 44 by 44 pixel hit areas and axe. The fixture retains eight ranked members, long nicknames, shared ranks and a full bar with the actual 20 / 16 total.

Hosted run 43253772741 attempt 1 failed on the inherited HUD keyboard expectation. After updating that existing test, nine focused managed Chromium cases passed, covering the keyboard path, both fixed-navigation axe cases and the six HUD viewport cases. The test follow-up changes no application files.

adversarialFindings.description: The provider and client used canInvite as an administrator flag. Changing that field to true for all members would expose administrator actions in existing clients, while the old adapter would reject a regular member's legitimate invitation code.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The upgrade adds canCreateInvite and preserves the legacy administrator flag. The adapter maps the capabilities separately and the guarded SQL allows invite after membership validation while keeping rename and revoke administrator-only. SQL, adapter and browser tests cover the resulting boundaries.

adversarialFindings.description: Hosted certification found that the existing keyboard journey expected Settings directly after Activity, although the required Guild link now receives focus in between.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The test now checks the Guild link in sequence, its route destination and visible focus before continuing through Settings and the quest action. The targeted keyboard and adjacent accessibility checks passed.

adversarialFindings.description: The first 320px Glassmorphic screenshot showed a valid long Guild name splitting inside words and leaving a letter on its own line. The icon gutter narrowed the entire identity block.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Reserve the icon gutter only on the section-label row. The heading and member count use the full card width, with word-breaking as an overflow fallback. Browser geometry and inspected screenshots confirm the 40-character name renders intact at 320 CSS pixels and native 200% zoom.

adversarialFindings.description: The inherited command handler discarded the confirmed board after a transient refresh failure. Keyboard reactivation while a read is pending also needs to respect the same in-flight guard as pointer input.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The refresh uses the existing explicit read and in-flight guard, exposes its disabled state while retaining keyboard focus, and preserves the confirmed board on unavailable or rate-limited reads. The browser case holds a request, presses Enter again, returns a 503 and verifies one read, retained rows and a successful retry.

adversarialFindings.description: Moving the share action away from Administration could expose it without confirmed membership, omit the privacy explanation or lose feedback when a stale membership is rejected.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Min uke composes the existing account-bound command and nearby disclosure only when sharing is available. Feedback remains visible if the operation clears the board. Browser evidence covers no passive reads, offline and account isolation, exact date-and-membership input, successful RPG and Classic shares and stale membership rejection.

retrospective.summary: The reviewed payload is ready for hosted certification. The browser uses simulated Nhost transport. Merge requires the authorized member-invites.sql upgrade and authenticated verification on progresspal-g0. The installed function definition has not been read back in this session, and the new SQL has not been applied live.
